title: UMUJYI WA KIGALI v. SNATCO Ltd
text:
UMUJYI WA KIGALI v. SNATCO Ltd
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RADAA00022/2024/CA (Ngagi, J. P.) 20 Gashyantare 2026]
Amategeko agenga ububasha bw’inkiko – Ihame ryo kubahiriza umurongo wafashwe – Iyo ikibazo
urukiko rwashyikirijwe kidasa neza n’icyakemuwe mu rubanza rutanga umurongo, icyo igihe urwo
rubanza ntirushingirwaho.
Amategeko agenga imanza z’ubutegetsi – Ubutaka bwa Leta – Igishanga gikomye – Kwimurwa mu butaka
bwa Leta – Hatangwa agaciro k’umutungo wasenywe kubera ko uri mu gishanga iyo nyir’uwo mutungo
yari uwifitiye ibyangombwa by’ubutaka.
Amategeko agenga imanza z’ubutaka – Umutungo utimukanwa – Uburenganzira ku mutungo utimukanwa
– Uburenganzira umuntu afite ku butaka bugaragazwa n’icyagombwa cy’ubutaka ahabwa n’inzego
zibifitiye ububasha, bikavuguruzwa gusa mu gihe yakibonye mu buryo budakurikije amategeko.
Incamake y’ikibazo: SNATCO Ltd yareze Umujyi wa Kigali mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge
isaba guhabwa ingurane ikwiye ku mutungo wayo yari ifite, ukaza gusenywa n’Ubuyobozi bw’Umujyi
wa Kigali. Umujyi wa Kigali wisobanuye uvuga ko Urega atimuwe ku bw’inyungu rusange, ahubwo
yasenyewe kuko yashyize ibikorwa bitemewe mu gishanga, kandi igishanga ari icya Leta akaba ari nayo
mpamvu amafaranga y’ingurane iregera itagomba kuyahabwa.
Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwaciye urubanza rwemeza ko ikirego cya SNATCO Ltd nta shingiro gifite kuri
byose, ko SNATCO Ltd yubatse mu gishanga cya Rwampara kandi igishanga ari icya Leta, ko nta ngurane
ikwiye gutangwa muri urwo rubanza. SNATCO Ltd yajuririye mu Rukiko Rukuru, maze rwemeza ko
ubujurire bwayo bufite ishingiro kuri bimwe, ko ubwatanzwe n’Umujyi wa Kigali nta shingiro bufite,
bityo urubanza rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rwisumbuye ruhindutse mu ngingo zarwo zose, SNATCO ikaba
igomba kwishyurwa agaciro k’umutungo wayo wasenywe.
Umujyi wa Kigali wajuririye mu Rukiko rw’Ubujurire ivuga ko Urukiko Rukuru rwakoze ikosa ryo
kugenera SNATCO ingurane y’ibikorwa yashyize mu gishanga cya Leta, rushingiye ku rubanza rwaciwe
n’uru Rukiko hagati y’Umujyi wa Kigali na Gatete, nyamara ikibazo cyari muri urwo rubanza kidahuye
n’ikiri gusuzumwa muri uru rubanza na SNATICO. Uvuga kandi ko iyo ngurane itari gutangwa kuko
SNATCO yari yasabwe kubaka inyubako zoroheje akaba arizo yasabwe gukuraho ku butaka bwa Leta,
kuko nta cyangombwa cyaho yari afite, ko atari kugenerwa iyo ngurane hashingiye ku cyangombwa cyo
kubaka izo nyubako, bityo ukaba usaba gusubizwa amafaranga yagiye kuri uru rubanza.
SNATCO Ltd yireguye ivuga ko urubanza Urukiko Rukuru rwashingiyeho rwabaye hagati y’Umujyi wa
Kigali na Gatete ruyigenera agaciro k’ibikorwa byayo, isanga ruhura neza n’ikibazo yashyikirije Urukiko
kuko yubatse mu nzira no mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko nyuma yo kubihererwa uburengenzira
n’Umujyi wa Kigali, kandi itahawe agaciro k’ubutaka kandi yari yagasabye. Ivuga kandi ko icyo gishanga
yubatsemo kitari gikomye, ko Umujyi wa Kigali wiyibagije ko itigeze yihesha ubwo butaka.
SNATCO isoza ivuga ko ntaho Urukiko Rukuru rwari guhera ruyima agaciro k’ibikorwa byayo kuko
hatitawe ku mategeko yashyizweho nyuma y’imyaka myinshi yarahawe uburenganzira bwo kubaka,
ndetse ikanakoreramo ibikorwa byayo, ikishyura imisoro, igatanga n’akazi, ariko kuri ubu ikaba iri mu
bukode ahandi hantu, kubera icyemezo cyafashwe n’Ubuyobozi bw’Umujyi wa Kigali kiyitegeka
kwisenyera ngo kuko yubatse mu gishanga, kandi yari yarahawe icyo kibanza mu buryo bukurikije
amategeko, ikacyubakamo ibikorwa byayo. Bityo, ubujurire bw’Umujyi wa Kigali bukaba butahabwa
ishingiro, ahubwo ko isaba gusubizwa amafaranga y’ibyagiye ku rubanza.
Incamake y’icyemezo: 1. Iyo ikibazo urukiko rwashyikirijwe kidasa neza n’icyakemuwe mu rubanza
rutanga umurongo, icyo igihe urwo rubanza ntirushingirwaho.

2. Hatangwa agaciro k’umutungo wasenywe kubera ko uri mu gishanga iyo nyir’uwo mutungo yari
uwifitiye ibyangombwa by’ubutaka.
3. Uburenganzira umuntu afite ku butaka bugaragazwa n’icyagombwa cy’ubutaka ahabwa n’inzego
zibifitiye ububasha, bikavuguruzwa gusa mu gihe yakibonye mu buryo budakurikije amategeko.
Ubujurire bufite ishingiro.
Ibyategetswe mu rubanza rujuririrwa bikuweho.
Amagarama aherera ku isanduku ya Leta.
Amategeko yashingiweho:
Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika y’u Rwanda ryo mu 2023, ingingo ya 34.
Itegeko Nº 22/2018 ryo ku wa 29/04/2018 ryerekeye imiburanishirize y’imanza z’imbonezamubano,
iz’ubucuruzi, iz’umurimo n’iz’ubutegetsi, ingingo ya 111.
Itegeko No 43/2013 ryo ku wa 06/06/2013 rigenga ubutaka mu Rwanda, ingingo ya 19.
Itegeko Ngenga N° 04/2005 ryo ku wa 08/04/2005 rigena uburyo bwo kurengera, kubungabunga no guteza
imbere ibidukikije mu Rwanda, ingingo ya 87.
Iteka rya Minisitiri w’Intebe N°006/03 ryo ku wa 30/01/2017 rishyiraho urutonde rw’ibishanga, imiterere
n’imbibi zabyo rikanagena uburyo ubwo butaka bukoreshwa, butunganywa kandi bucungwa,
ingingo ya 6 n’iya 19.
Imanza zifashishijwe:
RADAA00003/2024/CA, Umujyi wa Kigali na Gatete Polycarpe rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa
14/06/2024.
RCAA00007/2023/CA-RCAA 00008/2023/CA, Bugabo Jean Pierre na Mbabazi Phoibe v. Musabwasoni
Asthérie rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 21/12/2023.
Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA
[1] SNATCO Ltd ivuga ko yari ifite umutungo wayo utimukanwa uherereye mu Mudugudu wa
Kabasengerezi, Akagari ka Kabasengerezi, Umurenge wa Muhima, Akarere ka Nyarugenge, mu Mujyi
wa Kigali muri parcelle ifite nimero 4530 wasenywe n’Umujyi wa Kigali uvuga ko bubatse mu gishanga
kandi mu nama Umujyi warabasezeranyije ko abasenyewe bose bafite ibyangombwa byose bazahawa
ingurane ikwiye y’imitungo yabo ubwo yakorewe igenagaciro, ariko kugeza ubu ikaba itarahabwa
ingurane, isaba guhabwa ingurane ya 295.000.000Frw hiyongereyeho indishyi y’atanu ku ijana (5%)
ndetse n’amafaranga y’ikurikiranarubanza n’ay’igihembo cya Avoka.
[2] Umujyi wa Kigali uvuga ko SNATCO Ltd itimuwe ku mpamvu z’inyungu rusange nk’uko
ibivuga, ahubwo yasenyewe kuko yashyize ibikorwa bitemewe mu gishanga kandi igishanga ari icya Leta
akaba ari nayo mpamvu amafaranga y’ingurane iregera itagomba kuyahabwa, bityo ko ikirego cyayo nta
shingiro gifite kuri byose.
[3] Mu rubanza RAD00010/2022/TGI/NYGE rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge ku
wa 18/04/2023, urwo Rukiko rushingiye ku ngingo ya 19 y’Itegeko No 43/2013 ryo ku wa 06/06/2013
rigenga ubutaka mu Rwanda ryakurikizwaga icyo gihe, ivuga ko ubutaka bwo mu bishanga ari ubwa Leta,
ku ngingo ya 87 y’Itegeko Ngenga N° 04/2005 ryo ku wa 08/04/2005 rigena uburyo bwo kurengera,
kubungabunga no guteza imbere ibidukikije mu Rwanda naryo ryubahirizwaga icyo gihe, no ku ngingo
ya 6 y’Iteka rya Minisitiri w’intebe N°006/03 ryo ku wa 30/01/2017 rishyiraho urutonde rw’ibishanga,

imiterere n’imbibi zabyo rikanagena uburyo ubwo butaka bukoreshwa, butunganywa kandi bucungwa,
rwemeje ko ikirego cya SNATCO Ltd nta shingiro gifite kuri byose, ko SNATCO Ltd yubatse mu
gishanga cya Rwampara kandi igishanga ari icya Leta, ko nta ngurane ikwiye gutangwa muri urwo
rubanza.
[4] SNATCO Ltd yajuririye Urukiko Rukuru ivuga ko Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge
rwirengagije nkana imiterere y’ikibazo rugamije guha agaciro ibivugwa n’Umujyi wa Kigali.
[5] Umujyi wa Kigali mu kwiregura uvuga ko ubujurire bwatanzwe na SNATCO Ltd nta shingiro
bufite, ko nta ngurane yahabwa ku mutungo wubatse mu gishanga.
[6] Mu rubanza RADA00083/2023/HC/KIG rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rukuru ku wa 01/11/2024, urwo
Rukiko rushingiye ku kuba SNATCO Ltd igaragaza autorisation de bâtir n° 15417/95 yo ku wa 28/4/1995,
yo kubaka mu kibanza nimero 4530 Rugenge, ikagaragaza “Fiche Cadastrale” yacyo na “contrat de
location à usage commercial”, no kumurongo watanzwe mu rubanza RADAA00003/2024/CA rwaciwe
n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 14/06/2024, haburana Umujyi wa Kigali na Gatete Polycarpe, rwemeje ko
ubujurire bwatanzwe na SNATCO Ltd bufite ishingiro kuri bimwe, naho ubujurire bwuririye ku bundi
bw’Umujyi wa Kigali nta shingiro bufite, ko imikirize y’urubanza RAD00010/2022/TGI/NYGE rwaciwe
n'Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge ku wa 18/04/2023 rwajuririwe ihindutse kuri byose. Rutegeka
Umujyi wa Kigali guha SNATCO Ltd 185.581.393Frw y’agaciro k’umutungo wayo wasenywe, ko
amafaranga yatanzweho ingwate y’igarama ahwanye n’ibyakozwe mu rubanza.
[7] Umujyi wa Kigali wajuririye uru Rukiko, ubujurire bwawo bwandikwa kuri
RADAA00022/2024/CA. Urubanza rwaburanishijwe mu ruhame ku wa 04/02/2026, Umujyi wa Kigali
uhagarariwe na Me Mukarusanga Florence, naho SNATCO Ltd ihagarariwe na Me Rwabusaza Thierry
afatanyije na Me Kayiranga Cyrille.
[8] Mu myanzuro no mu miburanire byawo, Umujyi wa Kigali uvuga ko Urukiko Rukuru rwakoze
ikosa ryo kugenera SNATCO Ltd ingurane y’ibikorwa byayo yashyize mu gishanga cya Rwampara, kuko
icyo gishanga kiri mu bishanga bikomye, ko rutagombaga gushingira ku rubanza RADAA00003/2024/CA
rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 14/06/2024, haburana Umujyi wa Kigali na Gatete Polycarpe,
kuko ikibazo cyaburanwe muri urwo rubanza atari kimwe n’ikiburanwa muri uru rubanza, ko kandi
rutagombaga gushingira ku burenganzira bwo kubaka kuri ubwo butaka SNATCO Ltd yahawe, kuko
yagombaga kubaka inyubako zoroheje, akaba ari nazo yasabwe gukuraho, ko kandi nta cyangombwa
cy’ubwo butaka SNATCO Ltd ifite, bityo ko nta ngurane y’ibikorwa yashyize kuri ubwo butaka
yagombaga guhabwa; usoza usaba amafaranga y’ibyagiye ku rubanza.
[9] SNATCO Ltd yiregura ivuga ko ubujurire bw’ Umujyi wa Kigali nta shingiro bufite, ko nta kosa
Urukiko Rukuru rwakoze mu kuyigenera ingurane y’ibikorwa yashyize kuri ubwo butaka, kuko
bwahinduwe igishanga gikomye n’Iteka rya Minisitri w’Intebe ryo mu mwaka wa 2017, kandi SNATCO
Ltd yarahawe ubwo butaka, ihabwa uburenganzira bwo kuhubaka, irubaka, inahakorera kuva mu mwaka
wa 1995, kandi ikibazo cyasuzumwe mu rubanza RADAA00003/2024/CA, gisa n’igisuzumwa muri uru
rubanza, bityo ko nta kosa Urukiko Rukuru rwakoze kurushingiraho; isoza isaba amafaranga y’ibyagiye
ku rubanza.
[10] Urukiko rushingiye kuri izo mpaka, rusanga ibibazo bigomba gusuzumwa ari ibikurikira:
1) kumenya niba Urukiko Rukuru rwarakoze ikosa ryo kugenera SNATCO Ltd ingurane
y’ibikorwa byayo yashyize mu gishanga cya Rwampara;
2) kumenya niba amafaranga y’ikurikiranarubanza n’igihembo cya Avoka asabwa muri uru
rubanza afite ishingiro.

II. IBIBAZO BIGIZE URUBANZA N’ISESENGURA RYABYO
1. Kumenya niba Urukiko Rukuru rwarakoze ikosa kugenera SNATCO Ltd ingurane
y’ibikorwa byayo yashyize mu gishanga cya Rwampara
[11] Uhagarariye Umujyi wa Kigali avuga ko atemeranya n’isesengura Urukiko Rukuru rwakoze mu
bika bya 12 na 13 by’urubanza rujuririrwa RADA00083/2023/HC/KIG, aho rwashingiye ku rubanza Nº
RADAA00003/2024/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 14/06/2024, haburana Umujyi wa
Kigali na Gatete Polycarpe, no ku burenganzira bwo kubaka kuri ubu butaka SNATCO Ltd yahawe, maze
rukemeza ko SNATCO Ltd igomba guhabwa 185.581.393Frw.
[12] Avuga kandi ko Umujyi wa Kigali warenganyijwe n’urubanza ujuririra, kuko inyubako za
SNATCO Ltd zari mu gishanga gikomye cyagenewe ubuhinzi, kandi amategeko ateganya ko inyubako
zose zubatswe muri bene ibyo bishanga zigomba gukurwaho, akaba ari muri urwo rwego wayisabye
gukuraho inyubako zayo kubera ko ziri mu gishanga, kandi Leta y’u Rwanda ikaba yarashyizeho ingamba
zo gukuraho ibikorwa byose bitemewe mu gishanga mu gihugu hose. Bityo ko nta ngurane y’ibyo bikorwa
SNATCO Ltd yagombaga guhabwa.
[13] Asobanura ko ashingira ku ngingo ya 6 y’Iteka rya Minisitiri w’Intebe Nº 006/03 ryo ku wa
30/01/2017 rishyiraho urutonde rw’ibishanga, imiterere n’imbibi zabyo rikanagena uburyo ubwo butaka
bukoreshwa, butunganywa kandi bucungwa, iteganya ko ibikorwa byemewe gukorerwa mu bishanga
bidakomye ari ibi bikurikira: ubuhinzi, ubworozi bw’amafi, kwidagadura, guteza imbere ubukerarugendo,
ubucukuzi bwa Kariyeri, ubushakashatsi, imishinga igamije kubyara ingufu, no ku biteganywa n’ingingo
ya 19 y’ iryo Tegeka, asanga inyubako za SNATCO Ltd zibarizwa mu gishanga gikomye, bityo ko ntaho
Urukiko rwagombaga guhera ruvuga ko kuba SNATCO Ltd yarahawe uburenganzira bwo kubaka kuri
ubwo butaka, ari ikimenyetso gihagije kigaragaza ko ubwo butaka butari mu gishanga gikomye, kandi
byari ikimenyetso kidashidikanywaho kigaragaza ko ubutaka buriho inyubako za SNATCO Ltd
bubarizwa mu bishanga bikomye.
[14] Asobanura kandi ko Umujyi wa Kigali usanga ibyemejwe mu rubanza RADAA00003/2024/CA
rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 14/06/2024, haburana Umujyi wa Kigali na Gatete Polycarpe
bidakwiye guhuzwa n’uru rubanza, kuko imiterere y’ibibazo byasuzumwe muri izo manza zombi bidasa,
Urukiko rukaba ntaho rwari guhera rwemeza ko SNATCO Ltd yakoreraga mu gishanga kidakomye kandi
atari byo, kuko nk’uko bigaragazwa n’urutonde rw’ibishanga byateganijwe n’Iteka rya Minisitiri w’Intebe
Nº 006/03 ryo ku wa 30/01/2017 ryavuzwe haruguru, ku mugereka waryo kuri nimero 647 hagaragaraho
igishanga cya Rwampara ari na ho ubutaka bwayo buherereye, kandi bikaba bigaragara ko ibikorwa
byemewe gukoreramo ari ubuhinzi gusa.
[15] Akomeza avuga ko Urukiko Rukuru mu guha SNATCO Ltd ingurane, rwashingiye ku kuba
inyubako zayo yarazubatse mu gishanga kidakomye, ngo kuko mu kuzubaka yahawe icyangobwa cyo
kubaka, kandi hashingiwe ku ngingo ya 19 y’ Iteka rya Minisitiri w’Intebe Nº006/03 ryavuzwe haruguru,
umugereka waryo ugaragaza ko aho yubatse hari mu gishanga, akaba asanga kuba yarahawe
icyangombwa cyo kubaka (autorisation de bâtir) bitavuze ko icyo gishanga cyari kidakomye, kuko ibyo
byangombwa byatangwaga ku nyubako zidakomeye ku buryo igihe icyo ari cyo cyose bikenewe
zakurwaho. Byongeye kandi ko ibyo iyo ubihuje n’ibiteganywa n’ingingo za 6,7,8 na 9 z’Itegeko rirebana
no kwimura abantu ku mpamvu z’inyungu rusange, zigaragaza ibishyingirwaho kugira ngo habeho
kwimura abantu ku mpamvu z’inyungu rusange, usanga hari inzira (procedure) binyuramo, atari ugupfa
kubivuga.
[16] Avuga na none ko Umujyi wa Kigali utigeze ugira umushinga wo kwimura SNATCO Ltd ku
mpamvu z’inyungu rusange, ko ahubwo icyari kigambiriwe kwari ugukuraho inyubako yashyize mu
gishanga. Bityo ko hashingiwe ku ngingo ya 26 y’Itgeko ryavuzwe haruguru, iteganya uburenganzira

abimurwa bafite ku butaka n’ibyabukoreweho, aho mu gika cyayo cya 1 ivuga ko nyiri ubutaka
bwagenewe ibikorwa by’inyungu rusanga, agomba kugaragaza ibyangombwa byabwo, n’ibimenyetso
bihamya ko ibyabukoreweho ari ibye, ko nubwo utemera ko yimuwe ku bikorwa by’inyungu rusange,
ariko ko nta cyangombwa cy’ubwo butaka ifite, bityo ko uburenganzira yishingikiriza bwo guhabwa
ingurane ku butaka idafitiye icyangombwa ntabwo ifite.
[17] Abahagarariye SNATCO Ltd bavuga ko ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 19 y’Iteka rya Minisitiri
w’Intebe Nº 006/03 ryo ku wa 30/01/2017 rishyiraho urutonde rw’ibishanga, imiterere n’imbibi zabyo
rikanagena uburyo ubwo butaka bukoreshwa, butunganywa kandi bucungwa, iteganya ko umuntu wese
usanzwe ufite ibikorwa biramba mu gishanga kidakomye kandi atari byo byagenwe muri icyo gishanga
(...) yashingiweho mu rubanza RADAA00003/2024/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire basanga bihura
neza neza n’ikibazo SNATCO Ltd yashikirije Urukiko kuko yubatse mu nzira no mu buryo bwemewe
n’amategeko nyuma yo kubihererwa uburengenzira n’ Umujyi wa Kigali.
[18] Basobanura ko ibikubiye mu gika cya 28 cy’urubanza RADAA00003/2024/CA ari byo byonyine
SNATCO Ltd yahawe n’Urukiko Rukuru, ni ukuvuga agaciro k’ibikorwa yubatsemo mu buryo no mu
nzira zemewe n’amategeko, ko itahawe agaciro k’ubutaka kandi yari yaragasabye; ko kandi nk’uko
biteganywa n’ingingo ya 19 y’Iteka rya Minisitiri ryavuzwe haruguru, igishanga SNATCO Ltd yubatsemo
kitari gikomye, kandi ko Umujyi wa Kigali wiyibagije ko itigeze yihesha ubwo butaka, kuko yabuhawe
mu buryo no mu nzira zikurikije amategeko, ikaza kubwubaka mu buryo no mu nzira zemewe
n’Amategeko. Basobanura kandi ko SNATCO Ltd yemera ibikubiye mu gika cya 13 cy’urubanza
rujuririrwa, kuko yahawe agaciro k’ibikorwa byari ku butaka bingana 176.744.480Frw, hiyongeraho 5%
nk’indishyi z’ihungabana kubera kwimurwa kubw’inyungu rusange, zingana 8.837.209Frw, zose hamwe
zikaba 185.581.393Frw nk’uko yagenwe n’Urukiko Rukuru.
[19] Bavuga kandi ko Urukiko Rukuru ntaho rwari guhera rwanga kugenera SNATCO Ltd 185.581.393
Frw, kuko yari ifite uburenganzira bwo guhabwa ikiguzi cy’inyubako zari muri icyo kibanza, hatitawe ku
mategeko yashyizweho nyuma y’imyaka myinshi yarahawe uburenganzira bwo kubaka, ndetse
ikanakoreramo ibikorwa byayo, ikishyura imisoro, igatanga n’akazi, ariko kuri ubu ikaba iri mu bukode
ahandi hantu, kubera icyemezo cyafashwe n’Ubuyobozi bw’ Umujyi wa Kigali kiyitegeka kwisenyera (le
fait du prince) ngo kuko yubatse mu gishanga, kandi yari yarahawe icyo kibanza mu buryo bukurikije
amategeko, ikacyubakamo ibikorwa byayo. Bityo ko hashingiwe ku ngingo ya 34 y’Itegeko Nshinga rya
Repubulika y’u Rwanda nk’uko ryavuguruwe kugeza ubu, iteganya ko abantu bose bareshya imbere
y’amategeko, basanga mu gihe haba hari abandi bantu bari mu kibazo kimwe na SNATCO Ltd bahawe
ikiguzi n’indishyi ku kibazo nk’icyayo, nta cyabuza ko iyo ngingo yubahirizwa ku ruhande rwayo.
[20] Basobanura ko mu bujurire bw’Umujyi wa Kigali, uwuhagarariye yemeza ko SNATCO Ltd
yakoreraga mu gishanga gikomye, ariko kandi atari byo, kuko icyo gishanga cyahindutse igishanga
gikomye nyuma yuko SNATCO Ltd ihabwa ubwo butaka, ikahubaka ikanahakorera kuva mu mwaka wa
1995, bakaba basanga kuyifatira icyemezo hashingiwe ku ngingo ya 19 y’Iteka rya Minisitri w’Intebe ryo
mu mwaka wa 2017 ryavuze haruguru, nta butabera burimo, kuko iryo Teka ryagiyeho nyuma, ku buryo
ritagira ingaruka ku bikorwa byabaye mbere yuko rijyaho, ko ari yo mpamvu ibyo bikorwa byavanwe kuri
ubwo butaka Umujyi wa Kigali wita ubutaka bukomye bitangirwa indishyi ikwiye.
[21] Basobanura kandi ko ibyo uhagarariye Umujyi wa Kigali avuga ko urubanza
RADAA00003/2024/CA rwaciwe ku wa 14/06/2024, Umujyi wa Kigali waburanye na Gatete Polycarpe
rudakwiye guhuzwa n’uru ngo kuko zidasa, nta gaciro byahabwa, kuko ikibazo cyasuzumwe muri urwo
rubanza gisa n’ikiri muri uru rubanza, kuko kirebana no kwimurwa mu gishanga. Bityo ko kuvuga ko izi
manza zidasa ndetse ko ikiburanwa atari kimwe atari byo, kuko icyasuzumwe muri izi manza
kidatandukanye kuko igisabwa muri zombi ari ingurane y’ibyari ku butaka bwari mu gishanga bimuwemo.

[22] Bakomeza basobanura ko ibyo Umujyi wa Kigali uvuga ushingiye ku ngingo ya 19 y’Itegeko
Nº43/2013 ryo ku wa 06/06/2013 rigenga ubutaka mu Rwanda bidahura n’ikibazo kiriho, kuko SNATCO
Ltd itayobewe ko ubutaka ari ubwa Leta, kandi ko ari na yo mpamvu yari ifite ibyangombwa byose
yahawe n’ Umujyi wa Kigali, biyemerera gutangiza ibikorwa byayo byo kubaka no gukorera aho hantu
yari yahawe, nk’uko Urukiko Rukuru rwabisobanuye mu gika cya 11 cy’urubanza rujuririrwa. Bityo ko
kuba Urukiko Rukuru rwarageneye SNATCO Ltd ingurane ijyanye n’ibikorwa byayo yari yarashyize
muri icyo kibanza yahawe n’Umujyi wa Kigali, rushingiye ku murongo watanzwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 14/06/2024 ku kibazo gisa n’iki nk’uko byasobanuwe haruguru, basanga bikurikije
amategeko.
[23] Bakomeza bavuga ko ku birebana n’ibyo Umujyi wa Kigali uvuga ko kuba SNATCO Ltd idafite
icyangombwa cy’ubutaka biyibuza uburenganzira ku butaka no ku mutungo yashyizemo ibuherewe
uburenganzira n’Ubuyobozi ni ukuvuga Umujyi wa Kigali, basanga izo mvugo nta shingiro zigomba
guhabwa, kuko gutanga icyo cyangombwa biri mu nshingano zawo hashingiwe ku kuba ari na wo utanga
uburenganzira bubanziriza icyo cyangombwa, kandi bikaba bitumvikana uburyo umuturage yahabwa
ubutaka akabwubakamo, akabusorera agatanga akazi, ariko byagera mu gihe cyo kwishyura Umujyi wa
Kigali ukanga kumwishyura ushingiye ku kuba utaratanze icyo cyangombwa ugaragaza ko nta
burenganzira awufiteho, kuko ibyo bitandukanye n’ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 34 y’Itegeko Nshinga,
iteganya ko abantu bose bangana imbere y’amategeko, ko uburenganzira ku cyangombwa cy’ubutaka
bugomba kuba bumwe ku banyarwanda bose ku birebana n’abubatse mu gishanga n’ahandi, ari na yo
mpamvu Urukiko mu kuyigenera indishyi rwatanze gusa iz’ibikorwa byari hejuru y’ubutaka, nk’uko no
ku bandi byagenze mu kubaha indishyi. Bityo ko ubujurire bw’ Umujyi wa Kigali nta shingiro bufite.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[24] Impaka kuri iki kibazo zishingiye ku kumenya niba Urukiko Rukuru rwarakoze ikosa ryo kugenera
SNATCO Ltd 185.581.393Frw y’agaciro k’ibikorwa byayo yashyize mu gishanga cya Rwampara
rushingiye ku rubanza RADAA00003/2024/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 14/06/2024,
haburana Umujyi wa Kigali na Gatete Polycarpe, no ku burenganzira bwo kubaka kuri ubwo butaka
SNATCO Ltd yahawe.
[25] Kuri iki kibazo cyo kumenya niba Urukiko Rukuru mu rubanza rujurirwa rutari gushingira ku
rubanza RADAA00003/2024/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 14/06/2024, haburana Umujyi
wa Kigali na Gatete Polycarpe, harasuzumwa niba urwo rubanza rusa n’uru cyangwa niba zitandukanye,
ku buryo rutagombaga gushingirwaho.
[26] Urukiko rushingira ku murongo watanzwe iyo ikibazo uwo murongo ukemura gisa neza n’icyo
Urukiko rwashyikirijwe. Ibi byumvikanishako, iyo ikibazo urukiko rwashyikirijwe kidasa neza
n’icyakemuwe mu rubanza rutanga umurongo, icyo igihe urwo rubanza rudashingirwaho.
[27] Mu rubanza RADAA00003/2024/CA rwaciwe ku wa 14/06/2024, haburana Umujyi wa Kigali na
Gatete Polycarpe, uru Rukiko rwategetse Umujyi wa Kigali kumwishyura agaciro k’imitungo ye yari
afitiye ibyangobwa ibaruye kuri UPI: 1/03/06/02/762, UPI: 1/03/06/02/415 na UPI: 1/03/06/02/763,
yasenywe n’Umujyi wa Kigali kubera ko aho yari yubatse hahindutse igishanga gikomye, ariko umutungo
yaregeye atari afitiye icyangombwa ntabwo yahawe agaciro kawo1. Ibi byumvikanisha ko hatangwa
agaciro k’umutungo wasenywe kubera ko uri mu gishanga iyo nyir’uwo mutungo yari uwifitiye
ibyangombwa by’ubutaka.
1 Reba igika cya 30 n’icya 31 by’urwo rubanza.

[28] Ku birebana n’uru rubanza, dosiye igararamo “autorisation de bâtir n°15417/15” yo ku wa
28/04/1995, SNATCO yahawe na Minisiteri y’Ibokorwa Remezo (MINITRAPE), ikaba yaremerewe
kubaka mu kibanza gifite nimero 4530 giherereye muri Rugenge. Dosiye igaragaramo kandi fiche
cadastrale y’icyo kibanza igaragaza ko abagikoresha ari Benda Samuel na Ruzindana Obed na SNATCO.
Iyo “fiche cadastrale” ikaba iriho amatariki abiri, iyo ku wa 12/01/1993, n’iyo ku wa 22/05/1989 ahanditse
mise à jour. Harimo na none inyandiko yitwa “contrat de location à usage commercial” igaragaza ko ayo
masezerano y’ubukode azamara imyaka itatu guhera ku wa 01/09/1994 akarangira ku wa 31/08/1997.
Dosiye igaragaramo na none, igishushanyombonera kigaragaza ko ibikorwa bya SNATCO Ltd byubatse
mu gishanga cya Rwampara. Dosiye igaragamo kandi ibaruwa Umujyi wa Kigali wandikiye SNATCO
Ltd, iyi iyakira ku wa 13/09/2017. Muri iyo baruwa, Umujyi wa Kigali wayisabaga gukuraho ibikorwa
byayo biri mu gishanga nta mananiza itabikora mu gihe cy’iminsi 7 bikazakurwamo kandi ikazishyura
ikiguzi cyo kubikuramo.
[29] Urukiko rushingiye ku bimenyetso biri muri dosiye, nk’uko byibukijwe mu gika kibanziriza iki,
runabigereranyije n’ibiri mu rubanza RADAA00003/2024/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa
14/06/2024, haburana Umujyi wa Kigali na Gatete Polycarpe, rurasanga izi manza zombi zitandukanye,
kuko Gatete Polycarpe yari afite ibyangombwa by’imitungo yasenywe, naho muri uru rubanza, SNATCO
Ltd nta byangombwa igaragaza byerekana ko ibikorwa byasenywe byari ku butaka ifitiye ibyangombwa.
Urukiko ruributsa ko umutungo Gatete Polycarpe atagaragarije ibyangombwa nta gaciro kawo yahawe.
[30] Urukiko rurasanga na none, impaka ziri muri uru rubanza zitandukanye n’izari mu rubanza rwa
Gatete Polycarpe ishingiraho, kuko muri urwo rubanza, Gatete Polycarpe yasabaga agaciro k’umutungo
wose yaguze harimo ak’ubutaka n’ak’ibikorwa byubatse kuri ubwo butaka, naho muri uru rubanza,
ikibazo gishingiye ku gaciro k’ibikorwa SNATCO Ltd yashyize ku butaka butari ubwayo, kabone n’ubwo
yari yarahawe autorisation de bâtir. Ikindi, mu rubanza rw’Umujyi wa Kigali na Gatete Polycarpe,
umutungo uyu atari afitiye ibyangombwa nta gaciro kawo yahawe, kuko Urukiko rwasobanuye ko
uburenganzira umuntu afite ku butaka bugaragazwa n’icyagombwa cy’ubutaka ahabwa n’inzego zibifitiye
ububasha, bikavuguruzwa gusa mu gihe yakibonye mu buryo budakurikije amategeko, nk’uko
byasobanuwe mu rubanza RCAA00007/2023/CA-RCAA00008/2023/CA rwaciwe ku wa 21/12/2023,
Bugabo Jean Pierre na Mbabazi Phoibe baburanye na Musabwasoni Asthérie.
[31] Urukiko rurasanga bigaragara ko SNATCO Ltd yubatse ku butaka butari ubwayo, nubwo yari
yarahawe uburenganzira bwo gushyiraho ibikorwa byayo. Mu gihe rero bimaze kugaragara ko aho
yashyize ibikorwa byayo itari ihafitiye ibyangombwa nk’uko byari biri mu rubanza Gatete Polycarpe
yaburanaga n’Umujyi wa Kigali, birumvikana ko Urukiko Rukuru rwakoze ikosa ryo gushingira ku
rubanza RADAA00003/2024/CA.
[32] Urukiko rurasanga, kuba SNATCO Ltd yarashyize ibikorwa ku butaka idafitiye ibyangombwa, ni
ukuvuga ubutaka bwa Leta, hanyuma nyirabwo ari we Leta cyangwa Umujyi wa Kigali ukayisaba
gukuraho ibikorwa byayo, kuko aho hantu hahindutse igishanga gikomye, birumvikana ko nta kindi
SNATCO Ltd yari gukora usibye gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo Umujyi wa Kigali wayisabye ikimura
ibikorwa byayo ku neza. Kuba rero itarabikoze bikarinda bisenywa, Urikiko rurasanga ntacyo Umujyi wa
Kigali ugomba kuyishyura.
[33] Urukiko rurasanga, kuba SNATCO Ltd yarahawe fiche cadastrale n’uburenganzira bwo kubaka
kuri ubwo butaka (autorisation de bâtir N°15417/15 yo ku wa 28/04/1995) atari ibimenyetso byari gutuma
ihabwa agaciro k’ikibikorwa yashyize ku butaka butari ubwayo mu gihe nyiri ubutaka yayisabye gukuraho
ibyo bikorwa ku neza ntibikore, bikagera aho bisenywa. Bityo Urukiko Rukuru rwakoze ikosa gutegeka
Umujyi wa Kigali kwishyura SNATCO Ltd 185.581.393Frw y’agaciro k’ibikorwa byayo byasenywe.
[34] Urukiko rurasanga ibyo SNATCO Ltd ivuga ko yashyize byayo byasenywe, mbere yuko aho byari
byubatswe hagirwa igishanga gikomye, bityo ikaba yaragombaga kugenerwa agaciro ka byo, nta shingiro

byahabwa, kuko icy’ingenzi atari igihe ibyo bikorwa byashyiriweho, ahubwo n’uko yubatse ku butaka
butari ubwayo; bikaba byumvikana ko igihe nyir’ubutaka (Umujyi wa Kigali) ategetse ko bene ibyo
bikorwa bitacyemewe, SNATCO Ltd yagombaga kwibwiriza ku neza ikimura ikimurira ibikorwa byayo
ahandi, aho gutsimbarara isaba ko yahabwa agaciro k’ibyo bikorwa, kandi izi neza ko nta byangombwa
by’aho hantu ifite.
[35] Hashingiwe ku bisobanuro bimaze gutangwa, Urukiko rurasanga ubujurire Umujyi wa Kigali
bufite ishingiro, bityo 185.581.393 Frw y’agaciro k’ibikorwa bya SNATCO Ltd, Umujyi wa Kigali
wategetswe kwishyura SNATCO Ltd avanyweho kuko ibyo Urukiko Rukuru rwashingiyeho rugena ayo
mafaranga bitahawe inshingo; bityo urubanza RADA00083/2023/HC/KIG rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rukuru ku
wa 01/11/2024, rurahindutse mu ngingo zarwo zose.
2. Kumenya niba amafaranga y’ikurikiranarubanza n’igihembo cya Avoka asabwa muri uru
rubanza afite ishingiro
[36] Uhagarariye Umujyi wa Kigali, asaba Urukiko rw’Ubujurire gutegeka SNATCO Ltd guha Umujyi
wa Kigali amafaranga miliyoni imwe (1.000.000Frw) y’igihembo cya Avoka n’ibihumbi magana atatu
(300.000Frw) y’ikurikiranarubanza yiyongera ku yo yasabye ku nzego zabanje ariko ntiyagenerwe.
[37] Avuga kandi mafaranga y’ikurikiranarubanza n’igihembo cya Avoka SNATCO Ltd isaba Umujyi
wa Kigali ntayo ikwiye guhabwa, kuko nta makosa wayikoreye, ko wayisabye gukura inyubako zayo mu
gishanga, kandi ibyo bikaba bidatangirwa ingurane.
[38] Abahagarariye SNATCO Ltd biregura ku mafaranga y’ikurikiranarubanza n’igihembo cya Avoka,
Umujyi wa Kigali usaba, bavuga ko yatangwa cyangwa ntatangwe hashingiwe ku migendekere y'urubanza
mu Rukiko rwajuririwe, ko ahubwo Umujyi wa Kigali ukwiye gutegekwa kuyiha 2.000.000 Frw
y’igihembo cya Avoka na 500.000 Frw y’ikurikiranarubanza hashingiwe ku ngingo ya 111 y’Itegeko Nº
22/2018 ryo ku wa 29/04/2018 ryerekeye imiburanishirize y’imanza z’imbonezamubano, iz’ubucuruzi,
iz’umurimo n’iz’ubutegetsi.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[39] Ingingo ya 111 y’Itegeko N° 22/2018 ryo ku wa 29/04/2018 ryerekeye imiburanishirize y’imanza
z’imbonezamubano, iz’ubucuruzi, iz’umurimo n’iz’ubutegetsi iteganya ibikurikira: ikirego
cy’amafaranga y’ikurikiranarubanza ni ikirego gishamikira ku kirego cy’iremezo kigamije kwishyuza
ibyakoreshejwe mu rubanza. Ikirego cy’amafaranga y’ikurikiranarubanza kiburanishirizwa rimwe
n’ikirego cy’iremezo. Gishobora kandi kwakirwa kikanaburanishwa n’iyo ikirego cy’iremezo cyaba
kitakiriwe.
[40] Urukiko rurasanga amafaranga y’ikurikiranurubanza n’igihembo cya Avoka, Umujyi wa Kigali
usaba ukwiye kuyagenerwa kuko byabaye ngombwa ko wiyambaza Avoka wo kuwuburanira,
unakurikirana uru rubanza. Urukiko rero ruwugeneye mu bushishozi bwarwo, amafaranga ibihumbi
magana atanu (500.000Frw) y’igihembo cya Avoka n’amafaranga ibihumbi magana abiri (200.000Frw)
y’ikurikiranarubanza kuri uru rwego, akaba agomba gutangwa na SNATCO Ltd. Naho ayo SNATCO Ltd
isaba nta shingiro yahabwa kuko ubujurire bw’ Umujyi wa Kigali bwahawe ishingiro.
III. ICYEMEZO CY’URUKIKO
[41] Rwemeje ko ubujurire bw’ Umujyi wa Kigali bufite ishingiro.
[42] Rwemeje ko imikirize y’urubanza RADA00083/2023/HC/KIG rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rukuru ku wa
01/11/2024, ihindutse.

[43] Rwemeje ko ibyategetswe mu rubanza RADA00083/2023/HC/KIG rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rukuru
ku wa 01/11/2024 bivanweho.
[44] Rutegetse SNATCO Ltd guha Umujyi wa Kigali amafaranga ibihumbi magana atanu
(500.000Frw) y’igihembo cya Avoka n’amafaranga ibihumbi magana abiri (200.000Frw)
y’ikurikiranarubanza, kuri uru rwego.
[45] Ruvuze ko amagarama yatanzwe ahwanye n’ibyakoze mu rubanza.
